steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each CAPA is placed by whether it is overdue and whether it was checked before closing.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 CAPA closed with no effectiveness check

findings.title: Closed with no effectiveness check
findings.fix: Check the action works, then close

findings.title: Overdue by more than 7 days
findings.fix: Re-plan the action with a new date

findings.title: Action does not match the root cause

outcome.notChecked: Whether the actions were carried out in practice.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] capa-0170.md:12  Closed with no effectiveness check.
       Fix: Check the action works, then close.
[medium] capa-0158.md:19  Overdue by more than 7 days.
       Fix: Re-plan the action with a new date.
[low] capa-0173.md:26  Action does not match the root cause.
       Fix: Re-check the root cause.
Not checked: Whether the actions were carried out in practice.
pros: Checks a CAPA overdue by more than 7 days, a CAPA with no owner, a CAPA closed with no effectiveness check, and a CAPA whose action does not match its root cause as recorded.
cons: Not checked: Whether the actions were carried out in practice.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-capa-status skill on the records for this review.
